title: Anthropic Adds UK Retail Component to Its U.S. Initial Public Offering
summary:
The developer of the Claude AI chatbot is enlarging the scope of its upcoming public debut to allow individual investors in the U.K. to purchase shares. Anthropic will launch a retail offering in the United Kingdom concurrently with its initial public offering in the U.S., where it plans to list on the Nasdaq.

The move is part of a wider effort to secure international funding, which includes a target of up to $3.5B from investors in Japan. According to company filings, the firm also intends to offer shares to buyers in Australia, Canada, and Switzerland, although it does not plan to list its stock in those jurisdictions.
